title: Pure Kashtira
summary: Pure Kashtira cards with generic Rank 7 Xyz Monsters and staples. Level 7 Kashtira monsters Special Summon themselves onto an empty board, search the next piece of the engine, and banish the opponent's cards face-down from their field, Extra Deck, and Deck.

summary.title: Starters
points: Kashtira Unicorn Special Summons itself when you control no monsters, searches a Kashtira Spell (Kashtiratheosis or Kashtira Birth), and banishes a card from the opponent's Extra Deck face-down.
Kashtira Fenrir Special Summons itself onto an empty board, searches a Kashtira monster (Kashtira Riseheart), and banishes a face-up card the opponent controls face-down.
Kashtira Ogre Special Summons itself onto an empty board, searches a Kashtira Trap (Kashtira Preparations or Kashtira Big Bang), and excavates the opponent's top five cards to banish one face-down.

summary.title: Opening: Kashtira Unicorn
steps: Special Summon Kashtira Unicorn and activate its effect to search Kashtiratheosis.
Activate Kashtiratheosis targeting Unicorn to Special Summon Kashtira Fenrir from the Deck, then use Fenrir to search Kashtira Riseheart.

Overlay Unicorn and Fenrir into Kashtira Shangri-Ira, then Special Summon Riseheart from the hand and banish Kashtira Big Bang from the Deck to banish the top three cards of the opponent's Deck face-down, triggering Shangri-Ira to lock a zone and Big Bang to return a material (Fenrir) to your hand and summon it.

summary.title: Face-Down Banishing & Recursion
summary.text: Every main Kashtira monster triggers both when it declares an attack and whenever the opponent activates a monster effect, punishing any interaction with face-down banishes. Scareclaw Kashtira and Tearlaments Kashtira Special Summon themselves during either Main Phase by banishing a Kashtira card from your hand or GY, giving you Quick Effect disruption and extra Level 7 bodies.

summary.title: Control
points: Kashtira Shangri-Ira Special Summons a Kashtira monster from the Deck during each Standby Phase, locks an unused Main Monster or Spell & Trap Zone every time a card the opponent owns is banished face-down, and detaches a material to survive destruction.

Generic Rank 7 Xyz Monsters—Number 11: Big Eye, Voloferniges, the Darkest Dragon Doomrider, Blaze, Supreme Ruler of all Dragons, Kerzebs, the Gaoled Glutton, Number 74: Master of Blades, and Number 76: Harmonizer Gradielle—pair with Shangri-Ira under Riseheart and Kashtiratheosis's Xyz-only Extra Deck lock.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Kashtira Birth lets you Normal Summon Level 7 monsters without Tributing, revives a non-Xyz Kashtira from the GY or banishment each turn, and banishes three cards from the opponent's GY face-down if they activate a Spell.
Kashtira Preparations Special Summons a Kashtira from the hand or banishment on either turn and rips a card from the opponent's hand face-down if they activate a Trap.
Kashtira Big Bang forces both players to banish monsters face-down until they control only one, and returns a Kashtira attached to your Xyz Monster when banished.

summary.title: Left out
summary.text: Kashtira Arise-Heart is Forbidden in the TCG. Kashtira Akstra requires banishing Visas Starfrost, which this pure Kashtira build does not run.

exclude.Kashtira Akstra: Banishes Visas Starfrost, which the pure list doesn't play.
